digest.component_or_area: LLM-Review voting gate on the production review bot
propositions: The production review bot must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to Bedrock inference profiles without cross-provider fallback, to dogfood the provider path rebar clients use.

The cutover requires filling three model-class slots (frontier/standard/trivial) in docker-compose.yml with bedrock:-qualified profile ids and adding --extra bedrock to the Dockerfile's uv sync command to provide the pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock module.

The safety net (kill-switch runbook entry, Bedrock client-error alarm, and pre-cutover VOTER_ERROR alarm validation) must be proven working before the model-class slot flip takes effect in production.

A real LLM-Review vote on a production change must be observed using a Bedrock inference profile, with provider_provenance stamping the provider correctly and the per-call usage log showing all calls routed to Bedrock profiles and zero direct-Anthropic calls.

The kill switch must be executed end-to-end post-cutover, reverting the class slots to restore the Anthropic path, producing a real vote on that path, and then re-applying the Bedrock configuration to prove the recovery lever works.
